answer: The network can discount fresh backing: delegated stake counts toward an identity's weight only after the delegator itself has survived several honest epochs, so a newcomer funded only by newborn accounts starts at the nadir of influence. A comet of a thousand fresh keys crossing the ocean of the ledger still earns nothing at dawn of the first audit, because age cannot be bought in bulk or parallelized. One honest agent gathers aged, patient backing over time; a sybil farmer funding a fleet from freshly minted accounts buys weight the ledger values at nearly zero.
